question: Related Questions Q. My question is that , say , there is a muslim boy and he has a non muslim girlfriend( I know it is not allowed to have even a muslim girl friend). This person has an affair with her and finally it ends up with their marriage , but the boy has converted the girl and she is a muslim now.So now this person has indeed done a great good deed and converted one soul to muslim. Now , on the other hand, there is another boy who always protects his gaze and does not even talks to girls ( fearing that he might break orders of Allah (S.W.T) ) so this boy would actually never be in a situation where he would convert a non muslim girl and thus can never do this good deed. Now My question is that , who is dearer to Allah S.W.T. more? the first one ( who actually first broke order of Allah by having a G.F. but then ended up with a very good deed) or the 2nd person , who was never in such a situation so he never did that deed? 2430 views Q. Regarding fake attendance signature 4757 views Q. Is it permissible for me to work in a computer department of a bank where I have to maintain and install computers nothing else. No bank related activity. Actually im working in software company in gurgaon but im facing problems like no mosque, no friday prayers, no muslim culture thats why im planning to go back to my native place (srinagar kashmir) but currently im getting job in computer department in bank. Can I do this job till I get any other job there? Please advise me. 3356 views Q. Allah has made me a software engineer by profession.Currently working in a reputed software company in India. I want to leave this company and start my own work as I do not feel my Iman each time so strong that I may be able to violate the cultures of the company which are not according to sharia like wearing pent shirt, Answering greetings of Na Maharam.Also things like the mendatory insurance component in the salary which I do not want to subscribe for, still deducted from my salary. In short these and some other things inspire me to start my own job.My parents have taken loan from bank.The loan includes interest terms also..Allah helps them to repay the loan via me.(However I am not the only source but Allah has made me as a major contributor towards repayment of the loan). Is this okay If I ask My parents to give me few months (2-3) to collect money by the salary instead of giving them and made investment in new work? However I have talked already to my parents about it that this new work may require some investment of a good portion of 2-3 months salary and they have given there consent. So the first question is what is better?Should I continue to work in the company and made small investments towards the own work (Which I feel a long process). Or go with the instant investment by putting the portion of salary towards new job which Allah gives currently to my parents via me.Ofcaurse success will be there only if Allah wills. My second question is regarding the new work I wants to start. InshaAllah it will be website based work initially. The plan is to provide a internet based facility to people where people can learn by there and other people's learnings. Learning means any learning what people may put on the website.Hence this learning can be according to sharia and opposite to sharia also. Like one people my place his/her learning as "Speak truth even in tough situation" and another one may place his learning as "Alcohol is good for health".So people may read both wrong and right learnings also.In addition the learnings can be of any other type also like business learning etc. Its like an opinion of someone by his/her experience. So the second question is such service/website allowed. The third question is about charging the people who use this service. Someone may be allowed to pay amount(as a fees of using this website) if He/She feels that he/she has benefitted via this website. So its upto that "Somebody" whether he wants to pay for the use website or not. Is such earning halal,(Please let me know even if its halal but undesirable)? Also should I set a maximum amount which a person can pay if he/she wills to pay? Please consider the use of this website for business organizations also where it becomes obligatory chargable. 3091 views Q. I am a software engineer. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 6704 Country: India Title: My wife afride for delivery time pain.so 3rd child no like she want family planing operation? what is shariyath law i am what doing? Question: Asalamu alaikum warhammathulli wa barakathu !!! My wife afride for delivery time pain.so 3rd child no like she want family planing operation? what is shariyath law i am what doing? Answer ID: 6704 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 657/657=M/1429) The concept of family planning is against Islamic teaching. It is haram and unlawful to have such operation which permanently removes the reproduction capability. You should politely get your wife convinced that it is a major sin. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
